message: Hand the name to the control
$reason: The wrapper of `name-on-focusable-wrapper` around a `role="switch"` with no `tabindex` of its own — g08 with a switch for the combobox. The switch is no widget of the tables (it takes its name from its content and no user lands on it), and it is a control all the same: a widget's role. axe reports `aria-prohibited-attr` on the wrapper and `aria-toggle-field-name` on the switch in three engines. Reading only the widgets of the tables inside passes it.
